'''Mike Rodriquez''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Fitchburg tournament]] on 11 March 2001 with Deadbolt, according to Steve Baroni's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1899">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-14-playstation-parted1899/ playstation-parte], DeckTech (steve "stevie B" baroni, 14 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-14-playstation-parted1899/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
